title: NGk
desc: Nandha Gopalan Kumaran, a social worker, is forced to join politics to help his village. He faces various obstacles while learning the tricks to survive in power.

title: Trigger
desc: An undercover police officer locks horns with a gangster after his adopted niece is kidnapped. Later he learns how the kidnappings of children are connected to his father, a former policeman.

title: Eleven
desc: A seasoned police officer begins an investigation after a series of gruesome murders targeting twins comes to light. However, he soon encounters a sinister game of psychological manipulation.

title: Mandela
desc: In a small village, two political parties compete in the local elections and are ready to win at any cost. In a twist of fate, the single deciding vote comes down to a small-time barber.

title: Pulimurugan
desc: A small village seeks help from a man with extraordinary force to protect them against man-eating tigers and the drug mafia.

title: Bharath Ennum Naan
desc: A graduate from Oxford is forced to take up his father's position as the chief minister after his sudden death. Later, he tries to reform the corrupt society but faces obstacles from his enemies.

title: Bengal Tiger
desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

title: Power
desc: Jeetu, a young man, wants to join the force but is discouraged by his brother-in-law, a police officer. A dejected Jeetu steals his uniform and goes around pretending to be an officer of the law.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Das Ka Dhamki
desc: A financially struggling waiter's life drastically changes course when he learns of his rich lookalike, the CEO of a pharmaceutical company.

title: Romeo
desc: Arivu desires a real love connection but ends up with Leela, who marries him out of family obligation. However, despite their differences, he tries his best to win her over.

title: Ethir Neechal
desc: When a man's deception about his real name is revealed, he is compelled to join a marathon to prove himself to his lover.

title: Max
desc: Inspector Arjun arrests two men for crashing into the police station. Soon, he desperately rushes to clear his name as the two are found dead.

title: Nenjamundu Nermaiyundu Odu Raja
desc: Youngsters Shiva and Vicky earn a living making videos on a digital platform and prank Jeepakaran, a businessman. However, Jeepakaran asks them to work for him in return for money.

title: Madhagaja
desc: The wife of one of two rival dons sends her son to a distant land to shield him from their relentless feud. However, the son, raised as an orphan, eventually returns to the brutal world of violence.

title: Pathaan
desc: A Pakistani general hires a private terror outfit to conduct attacks in India while Pathaan, an Indian secret agent, is on a mission to form a special unit.
